purpose: Form INC-33 is used as the e-Memorandum of Association (e-MOA) filed along with SPICe+ (INC-32) for the incorporation of a company.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the SPICe+ application form INC-32.
Prepare the e-Memorandum of Association in Form No. INC-33.
File Form INC-33 along with SPICe+ and Form INC-34 with the Registrar.
checklist: Ensure the application falls under Rule 38 for company incorporation.
Check if the company type requires Form INC-33 instead of alternative formats.
watch: Certain company types or conditions require alternative memorandum forms or formats instead of INC-33.
